verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents a risk-and-fraud-management area. It covers 3D Secure with a risk score and configurable rules that force a challenge, merchant, category and merchant-ID blocking, and escalation of fraud claims to the card brands. These cover only a slice of the story. The 3DS webhook delivers challenges to the cardholder and is not a suspicious-activity alert. Missing for 10: network or proprietary fraud scores surfaced at card authorization time, suspicious-activity alerts to ops, tooling to block and reissue compromised cards, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, the platform fights fraud on my issued cards — network fraud scores or its own models surfaced at auth time, suspicious-activity alerts, and tooling to block and reissue compromised cards
